text: What is the role of the random input mask in the delay reservoir?
choices: It multiplexes the input across virtual nodes (playing the role of W_in), driving each node differently and breaking the symmetry of the ring
It trains the readout weights online during the forward pass
It sets the feedback delay length τ and hence the number of nodes
It removes the nonlinearity so the node behaves linearly
explanation: The static random mask (m_i ∈ [−0.5, 0.5] in the lab) projects the scalar input onto the N virtual nodes — the physical analog of the input matrix W_in — so each node is driven differently; without it the ring's nodes would all receive the same input and collapse to identical states. It is not a trainer (option 1), does not set the delay/node count (option 2 — that is fixed by θ and τ), and does not linearize the node (option 3).
